name: AI composer
summary: Where a person asks an assistant something: attached sources (one still reading), a mode switch, and a send button that stays quiet until there is text.
use: where people ask an assistant a question with files or sources attached
a11y: A labelled form: the modes are a native radio group, every icon button has a name, and the focus ring wraps the whole box.

use_when: a research or study tool where the answer must come from the person's own documents
a chat screen that needs a few starter questions before the first message
avoid_when: a plain search box with no assistant: use command-menu
showing the assistant's answer: this is only the input side

parts.name: sources
parts.what: one attached source: name, size or reading progress, and a remove button

parts.name: question
parts.what: where the person types; grows with the text

parts.name: attach
parts.what: icon button to attach another source

parts.name: modes
parts.what: one mode in a radio switch

parts.name: hint
parts.what: the Enter-to-send shortcut, hidden on narrow screens

parts.name: send
parts.what: the send button, greyed while the box is empty

parts.name: starters
parts.what: one suggested question that fills the box

empty.how: an empty box shows the placeholder and the send button turns grey

loading.how: a source still being read spins its icon and shows its progress

error.how: if a source fails to read, mark its chip with a warning icon and text in place of the progress, or put an alert-banners line above the box

disabled.how: the send button looks disabled while the box is empty, and the script ignores an empty send

overflow.how: the text box grows to a limit and then scrolls; source chips wrap to more lines

long_text.how: long source names are cut with an ellipsis

keyboard: Tab moves through the remove buttons, the question box, the attach button, the mode switch, Send and the starter questions
Enter in the question box sends; Shift+Enter adds a new line
Arrow keys move between the modes, as in any native radio group
Enter or Space on a starter question puts its text in the box and moves focus there
